You spent a fortune on a green ID card.....
Don't blow your cover.....
info.screen.roleid.crime_scapegoat:
You're a criminal with an instinctive sense for killing intent—but that same instinct makes your special identity easier to spot..

When someone dies nearby, you uncontrollably draw the knife you carry. If you're attacked while holding it, you fully awaken as a killer.
If you hold the knife and aren't killed, you feel the world's kindness, find your one-shot revolver, and stand for justice…
Spawns when the match has 10+ players.
Submission: Mst_Wu
info.screen.roleid.crime_scapegoat.simpl:

announcement.star.goals.flower_girl: A gentle bouquet may cut deeper than a blade.
info.screen.roleid.flower_girl:
The flower girl wanders the streets, trading fragrance for survival. Her bouquets can protect allies—or become sugar-coated poison for killers. That shield makes killers harder to counter-kill, yet slows every strike by a half-beat. She must decide who deserves trust.

Active: Gift Bouquet
Gift a bouquet to a player. While held, it acts as one shield layer.
You can outline that player for 60s; when they stand still, fallen leaves scatter on the floor.
Passive: Lingering Fragrance
Bouquet holders hesitate while charging, slowed by the petal scent.
When the Flower Girl dies, all bouquet effects on the field vanish immediately.
Submission: TITI
info.screen.roleid.flower_girl.simple:
A gentle bouquet may cut deeper than a blade.
Bouquet shield / lingering fragrance / death clears all
info.screen.roleid.swift_wind:
Swift Wind—dash! Dash! Dash!

Gale: press skill to dash 6 blocks forward.
Instant Cloud: sneak + skill throws a smoke grenade at your feet.
Passive Square Blade: on a throwing-knife kill, instantly gain another knife and put the knife on cooldown; after killing 2 players, immediately refresh Gale.
Psycho Mode: buy in the shop to gain 5 throwing knives and reset all skill and throwing-knife cooldowns, without a bat. Ends when no knives remain in the hotbar or offhand; the timer cannot end it while knives remain.
Submission: 21April
info.screen.roleid.swift_wind.simple:
Out of my way!!
Gale dash / Instant Cloud / Square Blade
announcement.star.goals.mime_killer: A theater of action—legend of the eternal actor.
info.screen.roleid.mime_killer:
The age favors noisy song and dance; mime rarely draws a crowd. Full of passion and desperate to be seen, he was disappointed again and again—until he boarded the train alone to stage a silent carnival of his own.

Portrait Mime (Active)
Aim at a player and press skill: they cannot move or speak for 10 seconds.
Silent Curtain (Passive)
No knife-raise sound. After a kill, no one can see the body for 5 seconds—passersby only see blood on the ground.
Theater Revel (Passive)
Can do tasks but gains no gold; each task reduces psycho cost by 50 gold.
Submission: haiyujiu
info.screen.roleid.mime_killer.simple:
A theater of action—legend of the eternal actor.
Portrait Mime / Silent Curtain / Theater Revel

Spend 400 on someone to fire up "press to ponder intellect" and rewrite their code!

Spend 400 to launch Code Edit and force-randomize that player's role!

announcement.star.goals.sin_wrath: Share victory with killers; fallen allies make you stronger and trigger frenzy.
info.screen.roleid.sin_wrath:
Wrath · Satan

Killer-share neutral. No shop/default items; no instinct, sees time.
Gain 1 Rage whenever a killer or killer-share-neutral ally dies. Each Rage grants one level of Speed and Haste, capped at III.
The frenzy threshold is the configured killer count for this round minus 1 (minimum 1). Each full threshold of allied deaths immediately starts or refreshes vanilla psycho mode.
While frenzied, you are fully immune to knockback and can left-click train doors with the bat to pry them open. Rage and frenzy progress appear in the lower-right HUD.
Shares victory with killers.

info.screen.roleid.sin_greed:

Independent neutral. While alive, take 50% of civilian/sheriff income and 25% of killer/neutral income. On death, distribute your balance among all remaining living players.
Right-click a player to take one inventory item at twice its unit price. Use the standard killer weapon prices and civilian faction prices. Unpriced items cannot be taken. Insufficient funds leave the item untouched and transfer your entire balance to the target.
Win when bound pouch kinds exceed half the starting population.

announcement.star.goals.sin_sloth: Put three players to sleep, then lie in a bed to win.
info.screen.roleid.sin_sloth:
Sloth · Belphegor

Independent neutral. 30s skill: every other living player within 5 blocks is guaranteed a sleep task next.
After a player completes two sleep tasks, their head appears in your backpack. Click it to put them into endless sleep: no movement, no voluntary wake-up, a fully black screen, and a visible sleeping pose. They gain one shield.
Breaking that shield wakes the player and immediately triggers the full Noisemaker ability. With three players asleep at once, lie in a real bed to win alone.
